qualityGates: All items independently authored; no copied commercial or secure NCLEX items.
Every item includes answer key, clinical rationale, option/response-specific rationales, clinical judgment tip, and public authoritative source references.
Every topic appears at least once; the 23 additional standalone items test distinct high-priority objectives.
All 13 QuickRN formats validated against schema and renderer.
Ten linked case studies contain exactly six questions in CJMM order and are shuffled only as complete groups.
Structural checks do not constitute clinical educator approval.
